section_a2_codebase_inventory.path_mapping_note: In the repository at VERIFIED_BASE_SHA=474ba080ec2cd740d39314109f279aacfa871376, the ingestion modules live under `backend/app/ingestion/` (rather than `backend/app/input_processing/`), and HTTP endpoints `/api/image/extract` and `/api/input/prepare` are registered in `backend/app/main.py` with `CACHE_VERSION = '132'`.

components.behavior: Dataclass holding `cropped_image`, `used_crop`, `crop_bbox`, `crop_holds_all_content` (L97), `page_boundary`, `skew_angle_deg`, `deskew_applied`, `illumination`, `is_blank_or_unreadable`, `blocks`, `problem_clusters`, `candidate_regions`, `ambiguous_multi_problem`.

Computes luma percentiles (p1, p5, p95, p99) and mean edge energy on 240px thumbnail; flags `is_blank_or_unreadable` when `(p95-p5)<12 and (p99-p1)<18 and edge_energy<1.8` (L214-218); detects uneven illumination/shadow via 80x60 HSV V-channel grid (`v_p90>=170, v_p10<=145, diff>=52`, L229-231) and applies local box-blur division compensation (`gain=(232/local_bg)^0.78`, L245-260) or gamma 0.82 boost (L261-266).

Detects paper sheet against darker or colored desk background in HSV on 320px thumbnail; preserves shadowed paper corners (`shadow_paper_s`, `shadow_paper_v`, L344-350); extracts largest connected component and crops when area ratio in [0.16, 0.90] and >=2 margins >=3%.

Downscales grayscale to `max_side=640`, computes `local_bg = BoxBlur(radius=14)`, and binarizes `diff = local_bg - work >= 20` (L435). Any faint stroke with local contrast < 20 gray levels is zeroed out.

Coarse-to-fine horizontal projection profile variance search (`-16..+16 deg` step 2.0, then `+-1.6 deg` step 0.4); applies bicubic deskew when `abs(best_angle) >= 1.2`, `best_var >= var_zero * 1.18`, and `_count_text_bands >= 3`.

Segments ink grid cells (`ink_sum >= 3`, L613) with 1-cell horizontal bridging; classifies `noise` (specks, book spine, page border, lone page number) vs `figure` vs `text`; attaches peripheral vertex/angle labels (`w<=9%, h<=6%`, proximity `<=4.5%`) to nearby `figure` blocks (L667-699).

Merges text blocks within `line_gap_thresh = max(14, round(img_h * 0.058))`, strips running headers/footers (L785-800), splits distinct multi-problem clusters when `v_gap >= max(18, round(img_h * 0.065))` and both blocks have `width >= 0.24*w, height >= 0.032*h`, and associates figure blocks with overlapping/adjacent clusters.

Runs full CV pipeline; skips crop when `ink_coverage < 0.96 or completeness_confidence < 0.78 or area_ratio > 0.85` (L1066-1087); computes `crop_holds_all_content = not desk_trimmed and all(chosen.bbox contains b.bbox for b in blocks)` (L1110-1114).

Runs `detect_problem_regions`; rejects blank/unreadable images locally with 0 VLM calls (`IMAGE_NOT_READABLE`, L298-313); returns `needs_selection` (`MULTIPLE_PROBLEMS_DETECTED`) with 0 VLM calls when `ambiguous_multi_problem` (L316-339); calls `extract_problem_from_image` on crop/page; decides `need_full_retry` at L358-372 (`not region_res.crop_holds_all_content` for `missing_regions` and `MISSING_PROBLEM_TEXT`, unconditional for `IMAGE_NOT_READABLE`); pairs diagram-only image with standalone user text (L420-434).
Deduplicates overlapping sentences across multi-photo captures of the same problem and reorders out-of-order hypothesis/question segments (`_order_same_problem_units`, L1044-1071).
Extracts uppercase geometric labels (`S, A', B', M_1`, etc.) from problem text and links diagram attachments without fabricating diagram-only facts.

Unified orchestrator for single/multi-image, PDF, DOCX, and composer text. Deduplicates identical normalized visual attachments by `anh.sha256` before calling Vision (L1337-1342) and merges or separates multi-image units.
Sniffs magic bytes (`%PDF-`, PK ZIP `word/document.xml`, PNG/JPEG/WEBP) independent of declared MIME.
Parses `word/document.xml` + Office Math (`m:oMath`, `m:f`, `m:rad`, `m:sSup`, `m:sSub`) deterministically with 0 AI calls; detects embedded images (`w:drawing`, `v:imagedata`).

Extracts text layer via `pypdf` with 0 AI calls when clean; falls back to `pypdfium2` page rendering into the visual pipeline for scanned/image PDFs (`MAX_PDF_PAGES = 5`, `MAX_VISUAL_FALLBACK_PAGES = 3`).
`VISION_SCHEMA_VERSION = 'photo-problem-extraction/1'`; strict Pydantic contract (`extra='forbid'`) plus Gemini transport schema (`VISION_TRANSPORT_SCHEMA`, L293).

Deterministic acceptance/rejection/confirmation gate (`CONFIDENCE_NEEDS_CONFIRMATION_BELOW = 0.85`); `apply_diagram_only_provenance_guard` clears `problem_text` when `has_problem_text=False` and `has_figure=True` so diagram-only images never invent problem text.
Process-local LRU cache (`_CACHE_MAX = 64`) keyed by `(anh.sha256, VISION_PROMPT_SHA256, cache_version)` plus in-flight `_dang_cho` future deduplication.

Enforces `MAX_IMAGE_BYTES = 10 MiB`, `MIN_SIDE_PX = 64`, `MAX_SIDE_PX = 2048`, `MAX_TOTAL_PIXELS = 25,000,000`, applies `ImageOps.exif_transpose` + clockwise user rotation, strips EXIF/GPS metadata, re-encodes and hashes.

`CACHE_VERSION = '132'`; `/api/image/extract` (L1385-1430) and `/api/input/prepare` (L1433-1511) enforce guest trial check `_cong_luot_thu` and `ALLOW_LIVE_AI=0` emergency stop (`503 LIVE_AI_DISABLED`).
Staging up to `MAX_IMAGE_ATTACHMENTS = 5` photos or 1 PDF/DOCX (`themMotTep`, `themDanhSachTep`) silently in the composer with 0 background API calls until the learner clicks 'Dựng hình'.

components.symbol: Submit flow, user-edit preservation, candidate selection & confirmation gates
components.behavior: Calls `/api/input/prepare` once on submit; if `status === 'ready'` immediately chains `/api/analyze`; if `needs_selection` renders inline candidate cards; if `needs_confirmation` populates textarea so user edits are preserved and submitted directly to `/api/analyze` without re-running VLM on the image.

REAL_CAPTURED_IMAGE.note: Zero real camera photographs exist in the repository. All `photo-problem-to-scene/corpus/c01..c12` images were generated deterministically via `backend/scripts/build_photo_problem_corpus.py` (Pillow).

SCANNED_DOCUMENT.note: Zero physical flatbed/mobile document scans exist in the repository; PDF scan fallback tests render synthetic pages via pypdfium2/Pillow.

policy_comparison.description: Shipped Product Policy (`LOCAL_OCR_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY` + CV region/crop/dedup + `crop_holds_all_content` + Gemini Vision)
Single-engine local OCR (`tesseract 5.5.3 vie_fast`) with rule-only confidence/lexicon gate
Single-engine local OCR (`RapidOCR PP-OCRv6 small`) with rule-only gate
Two-engine cross-validation (`tesseract_vie_fast` text + `rapidocr_ppocrv6_small` symbol voting, `t_conf=90, t_uncovered=0.0`)

root_cause_location.vacuous_all_quantifier: backend/app/ingestion/region_detector.py:L1110-L1122 (`crop_holds_all_content` now requires `not desk_trimmed and area_ratio >= 0.25 and all(chosen.bbox contains b.bbox for b in blocks)`)

quantitative_findings.effective_contrast_cutoff_gray_diff: When secondary text stroke luminance is >= 228 on 248 paper (nominal contrast <= 20 gray levels, reduced below 20 after 640px downscale + BoxBlur(14)), `_adaptive_ink_image` zeroes the strokes out, so `len(blocks) == 1` and `crop_area_ratio == 0.1044` (89.56% of page cut away). Before the Section VIII fix, `crop_holds_all_content` was vacuously `True` (4/9 missed); after requiring `area_ratio >= 0.25` and `crop_area_ratio < 0.35` retry on `missing_regions`, `crop_holds_all_content` is `False` and all 9/9 cases recover `SA = 3` (0/9 missed).
quantitative_findings.far_bottom_normal_ink_finding: In `viii_08_separated_far_bottom_normal_ink` (normal dark ink at y=1180), `_segment_layout_blocks` detects 2 blocks (`len(blocks) == 2`), and merges them (`crop_area_ratio = 0.6314`), so normal-contrast separated blocks are captured in 1 VLM call.
quantitative_findings.safety_impact: Fail-closed preserved (0 wrong geometry answers served) AND full-page retry recovered 9/9 cases (up from 5/9) while keeping `c11_chi_co_hinh` at 1 VLM call (`area_ratio = 0.432 >= 0.25`).

section_a6_live_vision_readiness.readiness_note: Dry-run harness and `ALLOW_LIVE_AI=0` kill-switch verified (`LiveVisionDisabledError` -> HTTP 503 `LIVE_AI_DISABLED`, `Cache-Control: no-store`, 0 network calls). Live Gemini Vision accuracy on real camera photographs remains `NOT_MEASURED`.

legacy_photo_problem_browser_check_selec.finding: Line 493 queries `document.querySelector('#btn-photo-library').getBoundingClientRect()` inside `#photo-camera-dialog`, which throws `TypeError: Cannot read properties of null` because the `axo-camera-photo-fan-stack` wave replaced the camera dialog's left `#btn-photo-library` button with the in-camera photo fan stack / tray trigger (`#composer-photo-fan-stack`), moving file upload exclusively to `#menu-item-image-file` in the composer `+` menu.
